proposals.before: On the wuwu day of the second month, 繼善 was transferred. On the bingyin day, 恩普: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, 一日 was transferred. On the gengzi day, 萬寧: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: On the wuwu day of the second month, 繼善 was transferred. On the bingyin day, 恩普: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the first day of the ninth month, was transferred. On the gengzi day, 萬寧: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.reason: 「九月一日遷」means transfer on the first day of the ninth month; 一日 is a date, not a personal name.

proposals.before: On the wuwu day of the second month, 繼善 was transferred. On the bingyin day, 恩普: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, 一日 was transferred. On the gengzi day, 萬寧: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: On the wuwu day of the second month, 繼善 was transferred. On the bingyin day, 恩普: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the first day of the ninth month, was transferred. On the gengzi day, 萬寧: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.reason: 「九月一日遷」is a calendrical date plus verb, not a person named 一日.

proposals.before: On the guichou day of the second month, 書明阿: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renxu day, 命改名書敏.
proposals.after: On the guichou day of the second month, 書明阿: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renxu day, he was ordered to change his name to 書敏.
proposals.reason: 「命改名書敏」is an imperial order renaming 書明阿 to 書敏; the English left the Chinese verb phrase untranslated.

proposals.before: On the guichou day of the second month, 書明阿: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renxu day, 命改名書敏.
proposals.after: On the guichou day of the second month, 書明阿: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renxu day, ordered to change the name to 書敏.
proposals.reason: Literal English should render 命改名 rather than leave the Chinese clause intact.

proposals.before: On the gengchen day of the seventh month, 博啓圖秦阿。裕恩: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
proposals.after: On the gengchen day of the seventh month, 博啓圖 was transferred. 裕恩: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
proposals.reason: Source 秦阿 is unintelligible in English; table pattern and parallel cells indicate 遷 “was transferred” before 裕恩’s appointment.

proposals.before: On the gengchen day of the seventh month, 博啓圖秦阿。裕恩: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
proposals.after: On the gengchen day of the seventh month, 博啓圖 was transferred. 裕恩: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
proposals.reason: Literal English leaves garbled 秦阿 untranslated; parallel transfer formulas support reading as 遷.

decisions.after: On the wuwu day of the second month, Jishan was transferred. On the bingyin day, Enpu: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the first day of the ninth month, was transferred. On the gengzi day, Wanning: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
decisions.reason: s0093 九月一日遷 makes 一日 the calendar day, not a person; the prior idiomatic invents a transfer of someone named 一日. The proposal correctly redates the transfer but leaves Chinese personal names in the English field, so revise with romanized Jishan, Enpu, and Wanning.

decisions.after: On the wuwu day of the second month, Jishan was transferred. On the bingyin day, Enpu: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the first day of the ninth month, was transferred. On the gengzi day, Wanning: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
decisions.reason: The same Chinese 九月一日遷 is date plus verb, not a personal name 一日. The proposal’s calendrical fix is right, but literal English must also romanize 繼善, 恩普, and 萬寧 rather than leave them as Chinese characters.

decisions.after: On the guichou day of the second month, Shuminga: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renxu day, he was ordered to change his name to Shumin.
decisions.reason: s0210 命改名書敏 is an order renaming 書明阿 to 書敏; leaving that clause untranslated is incomplete. The proposal’s sense is correct, but English must romanize the names as Shuminga and Shumin.

decisions.after: On the guichou day of the second month, Shuminga: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renxu day, ordered to change the name to Shumin.
decisions.reason: Literal likewise must render 命改名書敏 rather than retain Chinese; “ordered to change the name to Shumin” matches the clause while romanizing 書明阿 and 書敏.

decisions.after: On the gengchen day of the seventh month, Boqitu was transferred. Yu En: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
decisions.reason: Chapter/Wikisource 秦阿 is corrupt; a corrected edition reads 博啟圖七月庚辰遷 before 裕恩’s Right appointment. Render the transfer in English, and romanize 博啓圖 and 裕恩 as Boqitu and Yu En instead of leaving Chinese in the field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 博啟圖七月庚辰遷。裕恩理藩院右侍郎。

decisions.after: On the gengchen day of the seventh month, Boqitu was transferred. Yu En: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
decisions.reason: Same source correction as the idiomatic line: 秦阿 stands for 遷. The literal must say Boqitu was transferred and romanize Yu En, not leave 博啓圖秦阿 or Chinese names in the English replacement.
